prompt:
Create one production 2D arcade basketball sprite sheet for Piper Quickstep on a truly transparent RGBA canvas. Exact layout: 3 equal columns by 2 equal rows, six full-body poses, 1536x1024 pixels. Keep each complete figure centered inside its own equal 512x512 cell with generous transparent space on every side; no figure, ponytail, hand, shoe, or shadow may touch or cross a cell margin. All figures face image-right in the same three-quarter view.

Piper is the same athletic adult human woman: warm brown skin, energetic face, bright orange high ponytail tied securely behind her head, russet-red basketball uniform with cream speed stripes and cream trim, matching red/cream trainers. Preserve believable complete human anatomy with exactly two arms/hands, two legs/shoes, natural joints and consistent body proportions in every pose. Keep her identity, outfit, face, scale and direction consistent across all six drawings.

Draw the six ordered poses of one overhead basketball pass. Frame0: balanced chest-level ready stance, hands prepared. Frame1: turn her shoulders and lift both hands above and just behind her head, feet beginning to brace. Frame2: load the pass overhead with elbows bent, knees flexed and torso coiled. Frame3: at tick7, extend both arms overhead and slightly forward into the single release, fingers open and body rising from the loaded stance. Frame4: high forward overhead follow-through with weight moving to the lead foot. Frame5: arms lower into a balanced recovery as she watches the teammate. The sequence must read clearly as an overhead pass, with six distinct silhouettes and no repeated pose. The ball is separate runtime art and must not appear in any frame.

Use a polished late-1990s arcade sports painted pixel-art style consistent with the existing JAMVERSE athletes. Transparent alpha only. No basketball, ball, sphere, dark oval, prop, floor, court, ground shadow, scenery, grid lines, text, labels, UI, extra characters, duplicates, cropped limbs, background, glow, or checkerboard. Keep all six figures fully separated by transparent gutters and safely within their own cells. Return only the transparent sprite sheet.

cleanup.method: per-cell largest alpha>=64 component; retain original antialias pixels within a2px dilation; remove alpha<8 and generated glow; uniform nearest-neighbor scale to <=330x330 and center in transparent512x512 cell; no pose rearrangement

review.notes: Rejected for pose separation. Frames1 and2 hold Piper’s hands in almost the same overhead position, with only a modest knee change. Frames3 and4 repeat nearly the same forward arm extension. Identity/anatomy are consistent, all six figures have two arms/hands and two legs/shoes, no ball appears, cleaned alpha is transparent, and all margins are at least91px. Preserve this candidate; do not pack it.

status: rejected source; insufficient pose separation; retained for provenance

separateBall.art: No basketball in source art; overhead pass ball must be registered separately at frame3/tick7 only after source review.
